notes.title: Craft In Abyss Patch 20210326
notes.notes:
We heard that some players have trouble on the controllers setting, we now introduce a brand new settings, such that players can switch the keyboard and the controller without disconnecting the controller.

Also, we introduce a Vsync setting to enable player to choose the frame per second easily.

We understand that UI and font changes are crucial, so those are the first things we focused on.

So here are the changes for this patch：

The information headings and the actual numbers are now shown in different colors, so hopefully, it'll be easier to read.
4. Balance Change: ; You can only have 2 effects activated now, down from 3

[img]https://miro.medium.com/max/700/1*pinj7tcZkZwygykUvdhogg.png[/img]

[img]https://miro.medium.com/max/700/1*4JM6OfPpJTdZbkXstxT0cw.png[/img]

We got rid of the super loud warning when you are low on health, it wasn't anything major, but we can definitely see how annoying it can be.

notes.title: First Major Update
notes.notes:
During the end of may, we finally released a demo for our upcoming game on Steam - Craft in Abyss. Now, after two weeks or so later, we'll be bringing you the first major update.

[h2]1. Visual Renderings[/h2]
[img]https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*ELVII0R_dRXI-FNHghDhmg.gif[/img]

We put a bit of a twist on the visual effects, so that it would give off a feeling of refraction underwater. What's more, we also tried to use more realistic lighting and coloring. Additionally, since it's harder to see underwater, and we're worried that our original choice of coloring would cause visual clarity issues, we swapped our palette around a little, while it may seem less like it is underwater, we believe that clarify should still be prioritized. Hopefully, you guys are now able to see every little detail on your screens now.

[h2]2. Game Pacing[/h2]
 [img]https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*NI0XVuFW1v888XjFXqKlUQ.gif[/img]

Actions are now automatically used whenever they are off cooldown. Players will no longer have to click on each action to use them.
From the feedback we've received, it seems like the base-building fans out there weren't really looking for tense fights that required them to concentrate too much on the battle.

[h2]3. Interface[/h2]
 [img]https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*qoij_oURK-txj8AqPqrG0g.gif[/img]

Motion UI design is often found in games nowadays, but that's something we don't have... yet. We'll continue on work on it and improve the UI's fluidity.
 
[img]https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*xYZfThBx9UdscdAYnamusQ.gif[/img]

We added a drag and drop system to the interface as you can see above. The new component creation process will be utilizing this new interface. The special properties and effects that the different materials have are also clearly visible at the bottom, so hopefully, it'll help players understand what kind of component will be synthesized.
 
[img]https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*s3W_ZA02pqDonKxGLHd3cg.gif[/img]

We also implemented symbols for the some of the stages to show the special ones. In the gif above, it is a Wreckage Stage, where players will be able to salvage a wreckage in order to obtain resources. Some of the other special stages are Shop stages, Laboratory stages etc.

[h2]4. Tutorial[/h2]
 [img]https://miro.medium.com/max/540/1*6L7wlGXXPMQpmlf_ARiiTQ.gif[/img]

We added a lot of "I" symbols in the new patch. You can now hover over them in order to understand what the current interface you are on is for.

[h2]Please add Craft in Abyss to your wish list![/h2]
If you guys do like and recognize our hard work and efforts, please do try out the new patch and add the game to your wish list. Your support is extremely important to us!.
